collection_scope: Fall 2022 and Spring 2023; released tables retain cycle label 2022
provider: University of Toronto Data Management Group

data_guide_findings.finding: Household K-12 count includes age 5-17 fallback when school level unknown. Neither a high-school category nor purely directly reported school stage.
School lookup could potentially distinguish schools, but guide directs users to contact DMG for detailed school list. Public CSV has no person-school records or lookup.

Published trip-attribute dictionary contains departure time, purpose, geography and straight-line/Manhattan distances, but no arrival-time or duration variable. Departures at consecutive activities do not identify travel duration.

decision: Retain Toronto high-school commute interval. Do not substitute all-school trip totals, age strata, school-bus counts or modeled network time.
remaining_evidence: Direct current high-school identity or audited current school-code lookup and person records
Actual travel duration or departure-and-arrival observations
Toronto resident selection, person/household weights and non-traveller/missing records
